text: Cud is a minotaur boss found in the torture chambers of Meirvale Keep in Northern Elsweyr. He is the bodyguard of Khasda.

Dagarha is an Orsimer residing in the city of Orsinium, Wrothgar. She is one of the Malacath faithful, a group of Malacath worshippers that believe they will be rewarded with immortality, nourishment, and constant battle in the afterlife, as a reward for their continued servitude.
Davis Nelaram is a Dunmer battlemage residing in Masseranit.
The Blade of mastery was a magical weapon that could be found in Zakhara, the Land of Fate.
Death's Head is a powerful Bone Colossus found in the Vaults of Madness.
Dominion Icecaster is a generic Icemaster residing in several locations in .
The Draugr Wight is a variant of draugr and a moderately-strong type of undead usually found leading several other Draugr in battle.

Blade of doom, also known as Shaeroon's scimitar, was an evocation spell that threatened one creature with injury from an invisible sword of force that was triggered by a condition chosen by the caster.

The Draugr Deathlord is a variant of draugr found in . It is one of the most powerful types of undead, and serves as the most powerful foe in many draugr-infested dungeons, in many cases the final boss of Nordic dungeons, guarding Word Walls, chests, or doors.
Draven Leonciele is a Breton werewolf found in Kerbol's Hollow and Renoit Leonciele's husband.
Dridyn Berethi is a Dunmer Battlemage in who resides in the cave of Sinsibadon.

Blade of disaster, also known as black blade of disaster, was a powerful conjuration spell that weaponized a rift in the very structure of the planes that could be used to cut through anything in its path. It could be learned by sorcerers, warlocks, and wizards
Drodda of Icereach is a powerful Nord witch who took over control of the Direfrost Keep.
Dremora Mafrekyn, called the Dremora Frost Mage prior to Update 5, is a type of Dremora that appears in .
Dresuu Var is a powerful spiritual Daedroth found inside the ruins of Skyreach Pinnacle.
Bleys Orltusk, also known as The Blade or as Old Tusk, was a dwarf shopkeeper in Blackhold, Fimbrul.
Duriatundur is an ice wraith found at Duriatundur's Killing Field in Coldharbour.
Emnard Bezons is a Breton ghost located in Crestshade, Rivenspire, in .

Evangeline Beanique is a Warlock of the Mages Guild and High Chancellor Ocato's personal guard. The Hero can only find Evangeline in the Imperial Battlemage's chambers in White-Gold Tower during "The Ultimate Heist" Thieves Guild quest.
The blade of the elements was a magical katana from Kara-Tur that may have appeared in Faerûn in the mid–14 century DR.
Even Bigger is a powerful Ogre acting as a bodyguard to Nokhailaedhaz, the chieftain of Sandgrubber Tribe.
Fight-Master Grel is a powerful Dremora warrior found in Sanguine's Demesne.
Fire Mage Linia is an Imperial member of the Blackcaster Mages Guild. She is found in Balamath.
The blade of roses was an enchanted longsword believed to have been crafted under the direct influence of Sune herself.
Fiendish Nightmare is a giant bat summoned by Allene Pellingare in Wayrest Sewers II in the region of Stormhaven.
Fire Atronach is a creature in . They are immune to fire damage and may be healed instead.
Belonging to a subspecies of daedra known as atronachs, the Flame Atronach resembles a faceless humanoid female in body structure, though covered in flame.
Bladebane was a transmutation spell that caused a bladed weapon to be temporarily more harmful to a specific type of creature.
Gamekeeper Ozzai is a powerful Harvester found in The Hunting Grounds, the realm of Hircine.

The Gatekeeper is a guardian to the Realm of Sheogorath. It is made up of the flesh of the dead who try to pass through the gates of madness (and its victims, as hinted by its creator Relmyna Verenim) and has the two keys (Key to Mania and Key to Dementia) for the two regions of the Shivering Isles (Mania and Dementia) sewn into its flesh. One of its hands is an oversized blade, axe, or mace which it uses to great effect against enemies. The Gatekeeper is not unlike a larger and more frightening version of a flesh atronach.
Gedna Relvel is a lich in . She is found in Old Mournhold within Gedna Relvel's Tomb.
Blade boots, or bladeboots, were nasty footwear with concealed, spring-loaded daggers in the soles, worn by some rogues and adventurers.
General Nazenaechar is a powerful Daedroth found inside the Imperial City Sewers.
Gilbert is a powerful Breton spirit found deep in Windridge Cave.
The Giant Snake Mother is a powerful giant snake found in the Bad Man's Hallows in Glenumbra.
The Bloodaxe was an enchanted battleaxe that was the personal weapon of the First Axe of Ruathym, Rhaumon Bloodaxe.
Glaring Eye is a powerful Watcher found inside The Seeker's Archive.
The Giantess is a creature that appears in and . It is the female variant of the Giant.
Gordol is a Dunmer Battlemage residing in the sunken vaults area of Ashalmawia.
Blade in the soul was a wizard spell from the school of enchantment.
Grothuska is a powerful troll found inside Exarch's Stronghold in Craglorn.
Grunt the Clever is a giant in . He acts as a gatekeeper of the Blessed Crucible.
Gregoire Henoit is a Breton ghost located in Crestshade, Rivenspire, in .
Blade of Destruction was the enchanted greatsword that once belonged to one of the original Knights of Myth Drannor, Jelde Asturien.

Haarvenu is one of the vampire bloodlines of the Iliac Bay area. Those of the bloodline are gifted in the school of Destruction magic, particularly elemental attacks. The bloodline dominates an area of High Rock - specifically the regions of Anticlere, Ilessan Hills, and Shalgora. They are the enemies of the Montalion bloodline.
The Guardian of Root Sunder is a powerful Lurcher found in the Root Sunder Ruins.
Gytha-Kitha is a Spiderkith spectator found at the Maelstrom Arena. As a friendly character, she cannot be killed.
Blade spiders were a type of monstrously sized spider with bladelike claws.

The Headless Horseman is the headless specter of a warrior who can be seen riding around the province of Skyrim on his ghostly steed at night, or staying at Hamvir's Rest during the day, facing its cemetery. He wields an iron or steel battleaxe and wears steel plate armor.

The Hiradirge were a renegade wizard group of Ansei during the last civil war in Yokuda. They were said to be masters of stone magic. Some say that they were responsible for the destruction of Yokuda. In 1E 792 they were defeated in battle, and it is said that, since they failed to conquer the continent, they had their revenge on all of Yokuda. The forbidden swordstroke they may have used is thought to be the ancient "Pankratosword" technique, said to have been the shehai of a first-rank Ansei. Rada al-Saran claimed to have been able to perform it, but it is unknown if he belonged to the Hiradirge.
Heritance Icecaster is a generic Icemaster residing in several locations in . They are members of the Veiled Heritance.
Bloodbark Grove was a grove of trees found in the southern stretch of the High Moor on the Sword Coast.
Hjordis is a Nord werewolf and a member of the Frostmoon Pack. She can be found under Frostmoon Crag with the rest of the pack.
Hist Shade Icecaster is a generic Icemaster residing in several locations in .

Lord Hollowjack, also known as Hha-Lugh-Zhek, the Lord of Mortal Fears, and the Fear Daedra, is a Daedra Lord whose demi-plane in Oblivion is the Detritus. He is also referred to as the Jaque o' the Hollow, a spirit which is known to haunt parts of Rivenspire. During the annual Witches' Festival, "night riders may find themselves headless," being "cursed to gallop headless through the night on dark and frantic steeds."
The Blessed Sword of Tyr was an enchanted greatsword wielded by Nayeli Goldflower in the late 15 century DR.

Iachesis was the Ritemaster of the Psijic Order and magister of the Isle of Artaeum during the First and Second Eras. Iachesis was said to be an extremely powerful wizard in his own right, having led the Order for over three millennia.
Imperfect is a large, artificially-constructed creature, guarding the entrance of Sotha Sil's quarters in . Two of them are found in the Dome of the Imperfect, but only one is functioning.

Ilmindil the Incendiary is an Altmer vampire member of the Undaunted. He is found with his companions at the Dead Wolf Inn in Shornhelm. He is also found in the Aetherian Archive, serving as a merchant mystic. According to him, he was once the kinlord of Sunhold.
A blindglyph was a powerful handglyph weapon favored by the Geomancers of Kadar used to blind their enemies.
Igozai is a powerful Ogrim found with Cassia Varo in the ruins of Abamath.

Inferniums are large insectoid creatures that can be found in the Deadlands in . They have Dagonic allegiances and are known to consume anything related to prestige, power and authority: from grand soul gems and lucents to high-ranking Dremora. They look like a bigger form of a skitteris.
Infernal Atronach is a type of a fire atronach that appears in . They are bigger than usual fire atronachs and appear during the disruption of the volcanic vents.
Bladebless was a powerful divine necromancy spell used by priests devoted to Tempus, enabling them to heal a wound by blessing the weapon that caused it.

Kagrenac, sometimes referred to as Kagrnak, was a brilliant magecrafter and engineer of the Dwemer, having gained many titles such as "High Priest," "High Engineer," and "Chief Tonal Architect." He was most well known for his work within the field of mythopoeic forces and for constructing the first Numidium. His own theories on making a new god are written in the book Divine Metaphysics.
K'Tora is a malevolent entity residing in the mind trap during the quest "The Mind Trap." According to Oriandra, K'Tora wields "powerful mind magic." He is later revealed to be a Sea Sload.
Killraken is a powerful Troll found inside Ilthag's Undertower.

The Blade Kingdoms was the collective name given to a group of six relatively small city-states nestled between Chondath and Chessenta in the region of the Akanal that contained mountain valleys of Akanapeaks and shores of the Akanamere.
Knight Richion is a Breton Vampire working for House Montclair found in an abandoned house in Northpoint.
Kynreeve Ykal is a powerful Dremora mentally torturing Rozenn Vanne in an eternal dream. To save her, he must be slain.
Laralthir is a Bosmer healer found in the Chapel of Dibella in Anvil.

The Blood Axe Smashers, who were also called the Smashers, were a Zhentilar patrol of wicked humanoids that operated out of Darkhold during the mid-14 century DR. The symbol of the Smashers was a large skull on a purple field which was designed to be an insult to the Purple Dragons.
Lamae Bal, also known as Lamae Beolfag, "Mother" Lamae, or the "Blood-Matron," was the first recorded pure-blood vampire in Tamrielic history and one of the last known surviving Nedes.
Lakorrah the Matron is a powerful giant scorpion found inside the Fearfangs Cavern.
Laurieae is a powerful Lamia found inside the Serpent's Nest.
Blast-globes, also known as blast globes, were a favored magical weapon of the Zhentarim. Their destructive potential was awesome.
Longstride is a giant residing in the Giant Camp with his mammoth, Thickpelt.

Lyra Viria, initially introduced as Lyra, is an Imperial who serves as the First Sword of the Order of the Hour. Upon killing Mirabelle Motierre, it is revealed she is The Black Dragon. In the Black Dragon's journals, she claims that she killed Lyra Viria, though this is later discovered to be figurative, as she left her life as Lyra behind when she joined the Order of the Hour.
Magdra Ibrai is a powerful flame atronach found in the ruins of Molavar in Craglorn.
The Blade Cliffs was a chain of dangerous high cliffs on the Sword Coast North, to the southwest from the city of Daggerford and to the south from the Lizard Marsh.
Magdra Tigun is a flame atronach that can be found in the Spellscar in Craglorn.
Malkus is an Orsimer vampire and high-ranking member of the Volkihar Clan.
Maleel al-Akir was a Yokudan prince during the First Era. He managed to obtain the Wabbajack, and was entombed in Asakala, where he later arose as a Mummy.
Blade Lane was one of the easternmost streets in Suzail that ran parallel to Torch Street to the west.
Maulborn Frost Mages are hostile characters residing in several locations throughout Deshaan.

Matriarch Drevlan is a Dunmer destruction mage in that is part of the Ghosts of the Tribunal Creation Club content. She the priestess leader of a heretical Dunmeri cult that worships the Tribunal at their temple in Ashfall's Tear, north of Raven Rock.
Merete is a Nord Battlemage and a member of the Mages Guild, holding the rank of Journeyman.
Blightguard was an enchanted tower shield created imbued with magics of the Wood Man.

The Miregaunt are mysterious creatures and large walking parts of the swamp, similar to Lurchers, found in Black Marsh in . Local legends associate the miregaunts with Hist trees, and some tribes believe they are called forth to guard, defend, or take vengeance on someone or something that hurt or hampered the Hist in some way. Lacking a head, they have a large cavity in its mid-section, sometimes filled with a stone, an ancient relic, or even a living creature.
Muzzled Owl Ice Witch is a generic Ice Witch residing in Kynesgrove.
Mulaamnir (Dragon Language: ) is an elder dragon that can be found in Sleepy Senche Mine in .
The Blood Plagues were a supernatural weather event caused by the wrath of the orcish god Yurtrus that led to widespread disease and death in the Sword Mountains during the .

Netch or Netches are jellyfish-like creatures that are herded and bred like cattle similar to guar. Although they possess a somewhat jellyfish-like appearance, they exist entirely out of water, sustained by internal sacks of magic vapors. The female is referred to as the betty netch, while the male is referred to as the bull netch. The child is referred to as a netch calf. They are peaceful toward other creatures unless provoked.
Nunatak is a powerful frost atronach who can be found in the Memorial District of the Imperial City.
Pelagius's Storm Thrall is a unique storm atronach appearing in the "Pelagius' Paranoia" section in Pelagius the Mad's mind during the quest "The Mind of Madness."
The blooded greataxe was a minor enchanted axe from the city of Elturel in the Western Heartlands.
Pelagius' Flame Thrall is a unique flame atronach appearing in the "Pelagius' Paranoia" section in Pelagius the Mad's mind during the quest "The Mind of Madness."
Phazkad is a Flesh Atronach that appears in . It can be found in The Vile Laboratory.

Prince Naemon is an Altmer Prince and member of the royal family of Alinor. He is the son of King Hidellith and Kinlady Tuinden, and the younger brother of Ayrenn. He is married to High Kinlady Estre. He later serves as the hidden main antagonist of the Grahtwood region and later again as the main antagonist of the Greenshade region in the form of a lich known as the Shade of Naemon.
Blade of memory was an evocation spell that created a magical weapon in the caster's hand.
Ra-Kotu is a powerful and enormous Air Atronach encountered as the first boss in the Hel Ra Citadel Trial.
Rakmath the Breaker is a powerful Giant Troll found inside the ruins of Skyreach Hold.
Rendrasa Malena is a Chimer spirit locked away inside the reliquary underneath Heimlyn Keep. She is one of two Chimer mages who created the spellplague at Heimlyn Keep. She worshiped Namira.
Blood Iron was a unique enchanted short sword created by Hekedder, a wicked barbarian shaman, many years before the late 13 century DR.
Rootbiter is a powerful Crocodile found in the Root Sunder Ruins.
Riza the Deathless is an Anka-Ra found in the tomb chamber beneath Anka-Ra's Vigil. While alive she was a champion of Emperor Tarish-zi. She uses Nightblade skills like Soul Shred.

Rufinus is an Imperial residing in Southpoint. Like most of the townsfolk, he was driven mad when Sheogorath cursed the place. He was granted powerful lightning powers which, in his drunken and mad state, has started abusing them with impunity.
Blades and Bardings was a ballad from the Sword Coast region, composed sometime in or before the mid 14 century DR.
Rulantaril's Construct is a powerful Flame Atronach found in the Crow's Wood.

Sadal is a bone colossus that appears in . He is one of the Brothers of Strife, and was imprisoned in the Tormented Spire until Tanval Indoril released him with the Coral Heart, in pursuit of vengeance against the Covenant. Sadal serves as one of the two main antagonists of the Stonefalls region, along with his brother Balreth.

Sanit-Kil was once a great Witch-Warrior. Sanit-Kil's Heart of Fire was obtained from him by Kinitu Nila, Ahaz's grandson. Ahaz is in turn defeated by the Nerevarine during the "Erabenimsun Nerevarine" quest.
Blades of fire was an arcane and divine conjuration spell from the first circles of magic that lit a weapon aflame. The spell could be used by rangers, sorcerers, wizards, and warmages.
Sepilisk is a powerful giant snake found inside the Fearfangs Cavern in Craglorn.
Shearpoint Dragon is a creature card in that is a part of the Heroes of Skyrim expansion.

The Simulacrum of Molag Bal is a creature that appears in the Barathrum Centrata after the Coldharbour Elite Guard of the three inner portals are defeated. It manifests as a projection of Molag Bal. In strength it is similar to a Trial boss and is incredibly power. When defeated, it explodes in a large radius upon dying, killing those who cannot outrun the explosion fast enough.
Bladeweave was an arcane illusion spell from the second circle of magic that affected the caster's weapon. The spell could be used by bards, sorcerers, and wizards.
Skeletal Cryomancers are enemies found at the Temple of the Mourning Springs. They use ice magic and an ice staff, and are more powerful than their magical counterparts, the Skeletal Pyromancer.

Skoorn, the Blizzard's Edge is a Xivkyn member of Coldharbour Elite Guard in . He can be found patrolling the sewers or in the Barathrum Centrata after the central portal is closed. He mainly uses ranged and AoE attacks.
Sister Ambritt is a Reachman member of the Icereach Coven. She is responsible for the harrowstorm that destroyed the nearby Kilkreath Temple and its inhabitants.
The blade of the High Priestess was the sacrificial dagger of High Priestess Hekta Szind of Sschindylryn in the late 15 century DR.
Steel-Tail is a powerful Daedroth found at Quickwater Cave in Cyrodiil. They have a unique item called Ingested Hammer of Cyrodiil's Light, which is a unique item found rarely.

Stormfist is a Storm Atronach that appears in found on Tempest Island. It has a unique shield called Tempestshield. He is summoned by Maormer near the second Conduit Stone. He will summon Storm Atronachs periodically (three at a time). At 20% health, Stormfist will send out rapid shockwaves centered around itself, making it necessary to defeat it quickly.
Stonebreaker is a powerful Giant Troll found inside Sanctum Ophidia.
Blackguard's greaves were a pair of enchanted medium armor ornate-plated boots that were once worn by a blackguard and later by a death knight they became.
Storm-Slave is a storm atronach that appears in Cat's Eye Quay in .

Stormreeve Neidir is a Maormer and the leader of the Sea Vipers. She acts as the final boss of Tempest Island, and is responsible for the storm that the Maormer attempt to use to level Malabal Tor and eventually conquer the rest of Tamriel. It is important for players to stay close to Neidir, while moving out of the large circular AoE she periodically summons. If anyone strays too far away, she will charge into them, knocking them back and dealing fatal damage in Veteran mode. She will also summon a lightning bolt to hit a player a few moments later.
Stoutheart Giant is a creature card in that is a part of the Heroes of Skyrim expansion.
Blackguard's gauntlets were a pair of enchanted medium armor ornate-plated gauntlets that were once worn by a blackguard and later by a death knight they became.

Swamp Leviathans were creatures that were indigenous to the swamps and rivers of Black Marsh, the homeland of the Argonians. Little is known concerning these abominations, but what is known is that they were massive aquatic predators that were rightly feared and respected by natives and visitors alike. Among their attributes were claws reaching nine feet in length, a spine-covered body, and a mouthful of razor-sharp tusks.
Supremacist Pyromancer is an Altmer member of the Supremacists residing at the Middens in Elden Root.
Swiftwing Dragon is a creature card in added with the Heroes of Skyrim expansion.
A Blackguard's sword was an enchanted longsword that was once wielded by a blackguard and later by the death knight they became.

Tenyeminwe is an Altmer battlemage and a Mages Guild member who wishes to leave Sadrith Mora, but is afraid to travel without protection, as she have been involved in a quarry with a member of House Telvanni.
The Blood King is a powerful Nede found in the Skyreach Catacombs. He can summon two ghostly Giant Bats to assist him.
The Devil Wrathmaw is a powerful Senche-Tiger found in the Root Sunder Ruins.
Bloodcut armor was a variety of magical armor, either hide or leather, that was available in the period between the Spellplague and the Second Sundering.
The Ebon Lord is a Bone Colossus found in the Ebon Crypt in Glenumbra, High Rock.
The Fire-Eater is a powerful Dremora mage found in the ruins of Sanguine's Demesne.
The Frost King is a powerful Nede warrior found in the Skyreach Catacombs. He can summon a Spirit Giant to assist him.
Captain Blau was a ship captain active in the Moonshae Isles during the late 15 century DR.
The Forest King, also known as Kestic, is a Nede spirit found inside the Skyreach Catacombs. He can summon Spirit Wolves and Bears to assist him.
The Gracious Beacon is a powerful Wispmother found in the Chiselshriek Mine.

The Imperfect is a world boss found in the Sanctuary of Verification. It is a powerful factotum created by Sotha Sil with the purpose of fighting challengers repeatedly in order to become stronger and smarter, with the goal to become as close to "perfect" as possible.
Bloodlord's Visage was an enchanted skull-shaped helmet of demonic origins from the depths of the Underdark.
The Planar Inhibitor is a Flame Atronach that appears in . It is the fifth boss in the White-Gold Tower.

The Silvenar, also known as The Voice of the People, is the closest thing the Bosmeri have to a great leader. They represent the immortal aspect of the Bosmeri spirit and resides in the Silvenar Palace.
The Storm King is a Nede spirit found inside the Skyreach Catacombs. He summons a spirit Wamasu to fight alongside him.
Bloodiron armor was an item enchantment that made armor become more effective for a wearer who shed blood.
The Spooky Bailiff is a unique Wraith found at the Ossuary of Telacar.
Thick-Bark is a powerful Spriggan found in the Root Sunder Ruins.
Thoreki is a Nord Werewolf located in either Riften, Evermore or Rawl'kha, in .
A bloodiron weapon was an item enchantment that made weapons that much more vicious when connecting with a vital point on a foe.
Timothe the Sharp is a powerful Skeleton boss found in the Forgotten Crypts.
Timberfang is a powerful Welwa found in the Valley of Scars.
Tiny is a powerful Flesh Atronach found in Grunda's Gatehouse in Coldharbour. It is tasked with protecting Molag Grunda.

Blueshine was a special magical quality that could be applied to metal armor, giving it a blue-black color and prevented it from being tarnished, becoming rusty, or being damaged by acid. It also allowed its wearer to hide significantly more easily.

Titus Valerius is a Nede from the First Era who has been sent forward in time by The Warrior, in order to stop the Anka-Ra and The Serpent. Heralded as one of the greatest warriors of the Second Era, Titus served under the evil Emperor Tarish-Zi as his champion for a time with the intent of betraying the Yokudan conqueror, but he died before he could do so.
Urlach, "Who Breathed Fire," was an Atmoran warrior who lived during the Merethic Era. He was one of the Five Hundred Companions.
Valaran Stormcaller is a Maormer member of the Sea Vipers and a boss encountered on Tempest Island. He guards the first Conduit Stone, which enhances the storm magic of the Maormer.
The Blushing Mermaid was a famous lower-class tavern in the city of Baldur's Gate on the Sword Coast.
Vavran Reni is a Dunmer Battlemage residing in the Daedric ruin of Ramimilk.

Varen Aquilarios, also known as The Prophet when the Vestige first meets him, is an Imperial sorcerer, Moth Priest, and the former Emperor of Cyrodiil. He is the founding member of the Five Companions, and plays a crucial role in the main questline of .
Varien is a powerful Flesh Atronach found with his master Gravecaller Niramo at Reaper's Henge.
Lord Bly Ruldegost was a proud and honorable member of the Knights of the Shield and the regent for the infant heir of House Ruldegost, circa 1368 DR.
Varlariel is a powerful Wispmother found inside the Aetherian Archive.

Vermai are eyeless humanoid Daedra found in the realm of Oblivion. These creatures rarely display much in the area of intelligence, however they make up for that in strength. They are known to be found in the service of Mehrunes Dagon.

Vilkas is a Nord werewolf resident of Whiterun. He is the Master at Arms of the Companions and a member of the Circle, the most formidable and experienced of their warriors. Like the rest of the Companions, he lives in Jorrvaskr in the Wind District of Whiterun. He is a Master-level trainer in two-handed weaponry and serves as the Dragonborn's shield-brother in several of the Companions' quests. He is also one of the Companions who can assign radiant quests to the Dragonborn. Upon completion of the Companions' main plot line, Vilkas can be recruited as a follower and becomes a potential marriage candidate. He can be recruited into the Blades if the Dragonborn talks to Delphine while having him as a follower, or as a steward if the DLC has been installed.

Booming blade is a basic spell of the evocation school often used by shielding swordmages, as well as swordmages of other styles. When a swordmage attacks a creature with their blade, they have the option to add sonic energy to their attack, using a field of thunderous noise to injure their retreating foe. Like most swordmage spells, the spell is charged primarily by the swordmage's intellect, though their durability adds to the effectiveness of their sonic attack, and more experienced swordmages cast booming blade with more power. Booming blade is among the easiest of swordmage spells to learn and can be cast at will.
Wamasus are creatures that were once known to have inhabited Black Marsh, and had been described as "intelligent dragons with lightning for blood."
The Web Mother is a colossal spider appearing as the final boss in "Silk Farm Hunt."

Winged Twilights are a type of Daedra found in . They are portrayed as humanoid, bat-like creatures with blue skin and purple hair done up in a ponytail. The are said to be the servants of the Daedric Prince Azura.

Boesild Aerasumé was a half-elf fighter and mage of Silverymoon. He was the eighth son of Alustriel Silverhand. He was known for being the most pragmatic of her sons. By 1370 DR, Boesild was also the Moonstars' regional agent for Luruar and the Evermoors region. He was the only one of Alustriel's children who got on well with Khelben Arunsun; the rest only just endured him for the sake of their mother.
The Wilderqueen is a character in . She is what Aranias became after mantling the Wilderking. Her powers can shape the land of Greenshade, and she is worshipped by the people as a deity.

]] Y'ffre, known as Jephre in the Aldmeri Pantheon and as Y'ffer in the Khajiiti Pantheon, is the most important god of the Bosmeri Pantheon. While Auri-El, the Time Dragon, might be the king of the gods, the Bosmer worship Y'ffre as the spirit of "the now." The Bosmer think that after the creation of the mortal plane everything was in chaos. The first mortals turned into plants and animals and back again. Then Y'ffre turned himself into the first of the Ehlnofey, the Earth Bones. After the laws of nature were established, mortals had some safety in the world because they could understand it. Y'ffre is called the "Storyteller" because of the lessons he taught the Bosmer. Some Bosmer still have the knowledge of the chaos times, which they can use to great effect, such as the Wild Hunt. In the Aldmeri Pantheon, Jephre is the God of the Forest. Some Bretons also worship him. During the early Merethic Era, Y'ffre actually "walked with [the Elves]," greatly influencing their cultural development. He allegedly was the one who taught birds to sing and gave springs their "tinkling ethereal tune." In addition to his appreciation of the natural world – which he bestowed upon the Bosmer – Y'ffre is worshiped as the God of Song as well as that of the forest, especially by most Wood Elven Rangers. According to legend, he sees all within distance of any body of water, regardless of size.
Ysolmar the Roving Pyre is a boss-level daedroth summoned by Lauron at Old S'ren-ja Docks in .
Blowpipes, otherwise known as blowguns, were a type of exotic ranged weapon.
Yolnahkriin (Dragon Language: ) is a dragon in . He serves under the "avatar of Alkosh," Nahviintaas, and has deceived the faithful of Sunspire into believing he is an aspect of Jode.
Zav'i is a Dagi Khajiit world boss found at Red Hands Run with her brother Akumjhargo. She uses frost magic.
Zeffij, Incinerator of Souls is a Xivkyn who may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. She primarily uses ranged and AoE attacks.
Bog Luck was a half-orc member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin, and the owner of the Carnath Roadhouse on the Sword Coast North.
Zymel Ozarus is a powerful Storm Atronach found with its master Anyaq in the Valley of Scars.
Zymel Hriz is a storm atronach that can appear at random Dark Anchors throughout Tamriel. It is one of the possible final Daedra bosses at Dark Anchors.

Bonecrusher was the enchanted weapon of the spirit hunter of the White Worm tribe of Vaasa.
Abel is one of the Master's super mutants, found at the Mariposa Military Base .
Absolute Zero, #4 of the Yukon Five, is an antagonist on the Cold Steel board game.
Angel is a super mutant who was cut from Fallout: New Vegas.
Boffo Arglebargle Cosgrove Bullwubble II was a male gnome fighter and owner of the tavern called the Furniture's Fate in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR.
Assaultron interns are unique hostile Assaultrons protecting Chief Engineer Lewis, found in the Burning Springs region of Appalachia .
Barry is a super mutant found at the watershed . He is found with Larry and Sally in the room behind Harry.
The behemoth is the largest and most dangerous of the robots used by the Calculator, the mad cyborg from Vault 0, in The Belt in 2197.
Bone blade was a spell that conjured a bladed weapon, made out of bone, that could be wielded by the caster or any of their allies.
Bear is a super mutant and a member of the Rusty Hooks in 2253.
Beatrice is a female super mutant, living in Hoover Dam in 2253. She is a possible companion of the Prisoner.
Big Mack is a super mutant living in the Wilson Atomatoys factory in 2287.
The Blue Sword was a title within the government of Archendale, one of the three anonymous Swords of Archendale. The Blue Sword was the battle-mage of the Archenriders.
Bessy is a unique deathclaw inhabiting the Nahant sewers in the Commonwealth in 2287. She appears in the Fallout 4 Creations content "Tale of the Beast Hunter."
Bruno the Strongbot is a unique Protectron at Nuka-World on Tour in Appalachia.

The Cult of the Mothman (or simply the Mothman Cult) is a religious movement in the region of Appalachia based in the exaltation of the Truth of the Mothman, though the term is often used by outsiders to refer to the largest faction, the Followers of the Winged One. Prior to the Great War, the faithful congregated in a small makeshift church under the Mothman Museum in Point Pleasant. Mere days before the bombs fell, Brother Charles experienced a vision, which prompted the cultists to seek shelter in the faraway Lucky Hole Mine. Following the War, mutant creatures resembling the legendary Mothman were seen across Appalachia, and the cultists eventually emerged from the mine to engage with them in various ways. The religion split into two major sects, which are bitterly at war; *The Enlightened, a relatively secular movement, were the first group to leave the mine. They fled Appalachia with the prophet Brother Charles to exalt the Wise Mothman, an individual mortal being, distinguished by its otherworldly fuchsia glow. *The Followers of the Winged One descend from those who remained in the mine (with the First Priestess of the Wood), and emerged later to carry out crusades, claiming considerable holdings in the region. Crazed and superstitious, they worship the numerous red-eyed "Holy" Mothman species as manifestations of their god of Light.

Bobby, or the Barbarian, was a barbarian and an adventurer from Earth and the Realm (no relation). He was a companion of the monk Diana, the fighter Eric, the ranger Hank, the wizard Presto, and his elder sister, the rogue Sheila, together with his pet unicorn foal, Uni.

Deathclaws, so-named for their signature massive claws, are a species of genetically engineered reptilian creatures originating from secret experiments by the United States government to create super-soldiers capable of carrying out high-risk, search-and-destroy missions in place of humans. In the wake of the Great War and their escape into the wild, the deathclaw population exploded and evolved to become an apex predator in the North American wasteland.
Dominic Moore is one of the four psykers, along with Gideon, Wiggum, and Lucy, that are kept behind a force field in the Master's lair beneath the Cathedral in 2161.
Duelbot is a robot boss summoned by the Mechanist in her lair in 2287. It is an Assaultron armed with powerful melee weapons.
A bo stick was a type of wooden staff commonly used in the land of Kara-Tur.
Ethyl is a glowing one test subject, held in the Chop Shop's containment area in Underworld .
Fist is an Institute super mutant and the leader of the super mutant clan at Trinity Tower in the Commonwealth in 2287. He appears .
Gail is a super mutant who came to Appalachia in 2103. She is loyal to the Crater Raiders.
Boots were a piece of armor (or clothing) used for defending the feet and lower legs.
Gary is a super mutant and member of Harry's squad in the Necropolis Watershed in 2161.
Goris is a genetically enhanced intelligent deathclaw residing with his pack in the abandoned Vault 13 in 2241. He is a possible companion of the Chosen One.
Gond is a super mutant member of the New California Republic Rangers. Although he fights for the right cause, he is like most other mutants.
The Bloody Longblade was an enchanted and vicious bastard sword that once belonged to Hadrian Colton, a rare item procurer from Waterdeep.
Gruthar is the leader of the intelligent deathclaws of Vault 13 in 2241.
Jason Bright is the non-feral glowing one leader of the Bright Brotherhood at the REPCONN test site in 2281.
The Jersey Devil is a cryptid found in Atlantic City . Its offspring are known as Lesser Devils. The Jersey Devil itself appears as part of the quest Sins of the Father.
Bloodstone double axe was an enchanted double axe from Tethyr.

Joshua Graham, also known as the Burned Man and formerly known as the Malpais Legate, is a Mormon missionary from the settlement of New Canaan and a co-founder of Caesar's Legion as well as its first legate. After three decades of service in the Legion, helping Caesar carry out his conquest of the former state of Arizona and much of the former American Southwest, Graham's strategic loss in 2277 to the New California Republic at the First Battle of Hoover Dam resulted in Caesar punishing him by setting him on fire and throwing him into the Grand Canyon, only to survive. When Caesar later sent the White Legs raiders to raze New Canaan and attack Zion Canyon in 2281, Graham rallied the Dead Horses tribe as their war chief.
Agent Kensington is a glowing one and federal agent in Appalachia.
Mars is the ancient Roman god of war and deity who is worshipped by members of Caesar's Legion.
The Blue Sword River was part of the River of Swords located at the border between Unther and Mulhorand in the Old Empires.
Mean Sonofabitch is a super mutant and member of the Westside Militia in 2281.
Neil is a first-generation super mutant residing near Black Mountain in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

Bone club was an arcane spell from the schools of necromancy and enchantment that allowed a wizard to transform a regular bone into a magical weapon.
Pyro is a member of the Forged raider gang in the Commonwealth, appearing "Hellfire Power Armor." He was added to the game as part of the next-gen update.
Scorchbeasts, also known by the code name Sierra Bravo by the Brotherhood of Steel, are creatures found in Appalachia and major enemies .

Strong is an Institute super mutant residing in Trinity Tower in the Commonwealth in 2287, thrown in a cell with wasteland poet Rex Goodman because he wants to obtain the power of the "milk of human kindness" from humans. He is a possible companion of the Sole Survivor.
Bolts of warding was a weapon-focused encounter prayer available to clerics during the post-Spellplague era.
T-800 is a humanoid assault robot who could be recruited in Fallout Tactics in 2197.

The Ghoul, born Cooper Howard, is a central character , along with Lucy MacLean and Maximus. Once a famous Hollywood actor in the pre-War era, after the bombs fell, he was transformed into a ghoul, spending centuries fighting and killing in the wasteland as a bounty hunter. By 2296, he is one of the most notorious killers around the greater Los Angeles area, respected and feared for his deadly marksmanship and unscrupulous beliefs. The Ghoul also appears in the Burning Springs update for Fallout 76, in which he offers bounty hunting quests to the Vault 76 dwellers.
Tiffany Brantley is a Fire Breathers initiate residing in Appalachia.
Bonesaw was a surgical tool occasionally used as a weapon, that possessed a minor enchantment.
Uthern is a super mutant member of the Master's Army in 2161.
Vera (AM-12) is an Assaultron that can be found in the Whitespring Resort.
Vincent is a super mutant in the Los Angeles Vault who guards the mad scientists. He appears .
The Blue Lynx Adventurers were an adventuring troupe for hire from the Sword Coast North in the late 15 century DR.
Wiggum is one of the four psykers, along with Gideon, Lucy, and Moore, that are being kept behind a forcefield in the Master's lair beneath the Cathedral in 2161.

The Apanda , also known as the Reaver or Apprehendr, is a recurring creature in the Final Fantasy series, first appearing in Final Fantasy V. It typically appears as either a demonic giant or a behemoth.
Armored Axeman is an enemy in Final Fantasy XV fought during the main quest Express Train for Trouble. It is a magitek trooper that wields an axe in one hand and uses its other hand as a gun.

Blue Blade may refer to: * Blue Blade, one of the nobility titles in Mulmaster, * Blue Blade, a folk hero and a gallant brigand from Cormyr, * Blue Blade, or Azurazor, a blue dragon sword, * Blue Blade, an office of the Heralds of Faerûn, gone by the 14 century DR, * Men of the Blue Blade, the adventuring troupe that uncovered the Tomb of Thelarn.

Armored Swordsman is an enemy in Final Fantasy XV fought during the main quest Express Train for Trouble. It is a magitek trooper who wields a large sword with one hand and uses its other hand as a gun.

Attacus, the Soulless, is an enemy in Final Fantasy XIII. It is the mark of Cie'th Stone Mission 51 and is one of the Undying. It is fought via a third Cie'th Stone in the D stages after every stage has been cleared in the Faultwarrens. The fal'Cie Titan creates a Behemoth King for the final task, but Attacus appears, slays the Behemoth King and faces the party in battle.
Cetia is a character in War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. Known as the Soaring Firebolt, she is a secondary protagonist of Another Story and is the crystal warrior of fire.
The book cache was one of the most respected libraries on the Sword Coast, located in the market district of Luskan during the late 15 century DR.
Crusader is an esper in Final Fantasy VI who can be acquired as a magicite. It is the ultimate esper, but summoning it also harms the player's party.

The Fire Gigas is a boss from Final Fantasy II. It serves as one of the bosses in the Mysidian Tower, guarding the spell Ultima. Firion and his allies must defeat it on their way up the tower. It later appears as a random encounter in Pandaemonium's secret room.
The Fire Drake is a Fire-elemental enemy in Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings. It is a Rank II Ranged Yarhi.
Bolworth was a courier dog who worked for the Sword Coast Couriers in the Rivington neighborhood of the Outer City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Firemane is a boss in Final Fantasy XII fought in the Garamsythe Waterway. It is the second boss of the game, and a fire-elemental horse.

Freja is a character from Final Fantasy Fables: Chocobo's Dungeon. She is the blacksmith of Lostime and the Oracle of Fire with the Guardian Beast, Phoenix. When Chocobo meets her, she has forgotten about her profession and the missing Raffaello enters her memories. She is the only Oracle that doesn't have a last name. She later goes on to help Chocobo in his battle against The Destroyer.
